title: projects add: a Python project gets the Go allowlist and no check command

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Observed 2026-11-11: the registered slicer project (pyproject.toml, no go.mod) had the built-in Go implementer allowlist and no check command, so the first `ork wave start` warned and refused; fixed by hand with `ork projects set slicer --preset python --check ...`. Wanted: detect the language at `projects add` (or when the first run plans) and suggest the preset and the check command from the project's AGENTS.md.
